notes.title: Minor Update #2
notes.notes:
Here's another update with just a few small changes:

-[b]Added a high-score display,[/b] which shows your all-time highest score whenever you die, and lets you know when you surpass it

-[b]You can no-longer collect energy when the center of your ship is colliding with a star (you can still collect orbs, but can't get any-more out of a star when in this state).[/b] This change prevents players from simply ramming through small stars, but still allows you to occasionally bump into them without preventing energy collection

-[b]Added a short grace period before you can click to respawn.[/b] This prevents accidentally respawning instantly when you are clicking frantically.

That's all for this update, let me know if you think anything else needs changing or fixing.

notes.title: Minor Update #1
notes.notes:
This is a small update with only two change:
- The game now starts in fullscreen mode (you can still switch to windowed with f11)
- You can now click to respawn after dying
